Sure, here are three practical ways to reduce overfitting when training a neural network:

1. Use a smaller dataset: Overfitting can occur when a neural network is trained on a small dataset, which can lead to poor generalization. To reduce overfitting, you can use a smaller dataset that is more representative of the real-world problem you are trying to solve. This will help the neural network learn the underlying patterns in the data rather than memorizing the training data.
